_note: Neutral template. Copy it to ecosystems.json (or name it in 'ecosystems_file' in actions_monitor.json) and edit. Each ecosystem groups the repositories whose name starts with one of its prefixes. 'tool' is the signing script of your own release tooling (optional: leave it out if you do not sign here). 'external': true = only reported, never dispatched or signed by this tool. The last group, 'rest' (prefix *), takes every repository that no other group claims, so nothing is left out by default: delete it only if you want the others hidden.
